doc.title: Frank Tiberi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 30, 2022

title: Herman's tryouts and Joe Lovano
summary: Herman tried new players out; Joe Lovano was hired and stayed three years.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: I think I read that when a new person came on that Woody would sort of give them a trial? Would hire them for a period of time to see if they were going to fit in?

Well you know he would have them play and of course I mean if they weren’t good you know at that time you could buy tickets at the airport right at the counter. So I mean he would let them go. But one example was — oh God, my friend — Oh I’m trying to think —Joe Lovano.

Joe Lovano was playing with the group and then he was hired for the first night and he sat in and he played and he got up and took a solo and after the night was over Woody come up to me and said, “What do you think?” I says, “Well did you hear his solo?” So he was there for three years. My dear friend.
